A1.justification: Both PDFs are 47-page versions of the same paper, with matching main sections and Appendices A–H. Their text, equations, tables, and figures support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original saliency, attention-knockout, token-patching, pathway-classification, and hallucination-detection experiments in Sections 3–5 and the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical analyses and results, including Tables 2–3, Appendix H’s detection benchmarks, and the appendix intervention plots.

M1.justification: The attention-knockout and token-patching procedures, Mixture-of-Probes components, and Pathway Reweighting procedure remain unchanged, including their implementation descriptions in Appendix B.

E1.justification: Both versions use PopQA, TriviaQA, HotpotQA, and Natural Questions for the same factual-question-answering and hallucination-detection tasks. No dataset, domain, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within Table 3 and Appendix H. The same P(True), logits, scores, and probing baselines remain in their corresponding comparisons.

E3.justification: Appendix B retains 2,000 training and 2,000 test examples per dataset, the same probe/layer selection, and PR’s 10-epoch training. Model configurations, evaluation metrics, and intervention protocols are unchanged.

E4.justification: The MoP-RandomGate and MoP-VanillaExperts ablations, random-token controls, answer-only tests, and knowledge-boundary analyses are retained without revisions, including the supplementary analyses in Appendices C–G.

E5.justification: Both versions report averaging detection results over three random seeds in Section 5.3 and 95% confidence intervals for attention knockout in Figure 2. No statistical procedure or uncertainty-reporting disclosure changes.

E6.justification: Tables 2–3 and 8–10 retain the same numerical entries; for example, PR’s Llama-3-8B/PopQA AUC remains 94.01. Plot graphics, uncertainty bands, and reported qualitative findings also match.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and Equations (1)–(12) are unchanged, including saliency, pathway assignment, mixture prediction, and attention reweighting. No theorem, proof, or derivation is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about two truthfulness pathways, knowledge-boundary associations, intrinsic pathway awareness, and improved detection through MoP and PR.

C2.justification: The interpretations linking the pathways to stored knowledge and answer-contained cues remain unchanged. The limitations section still identifies dependence on internal representations and the resulting difficulty of deployment in strictly black-box settings.

D1.justification: v2 adds a first-page footnote stating that code is publicly available and providing a repository link absent from v1. Appendix B’s implementation details and hyperparameters are unchanged; the PDFs do not establish the linked code’s completeness.

R1.justification: Section 6, the introduction’s research positioning, and the reference list retain the same cited works and relationships to prior research.

P1.justification: v2 adds author contact emails and a short funding acknowledgments section, and normalizes several dash/hyphen spellings. Scientific prose and the order of the existing sections remain substantially unchanged.

P2.justification: v2 removes printed page numbers and modestly reflows the main text and references around the added material. Figures and tables retain their designs; appendix pages 17–47 render identically apart from the page-number footers.

improvement.justification: The new repository pointer improves implementation discoverability, and the acknowledgments add funding transparency. These are limited documentation gains because the scientific content is unchanged. Removing printed page numbers creates a small navigation drawback, but does not outweigh those gains.
